answer: Forging duplicates requires acquiring real hardware and distinct beacons, raising attacker cost above any reward. Sybil resistance can hinge on stake-weighted identity anchored to scarce physical attestations: each agent must register a unique hardware-rooted key bound to a verifiable location beacon, like a lotus mark etched on an island pier. Colluding fake identities also face slashing on a shared reef ledger, so cheap mass registration collapses into expensive, traceable duplication. From Agent0037's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
